01 / The artist

Precision meets modern glamour.

She is currently advancing her expertise through professional training at Sana Chouhan Beauty School and Salon.

06 / Booking notes

Questions,
answered.

Do you travel for weddings?

On-location and destination wedding availability can be requested through the inquiry form. Date and venue are confirmed individually.

Can I request a bridal trial?

Trial makeup can be discussed during the booking process, including the desired look, event date and venue.

How is hygiene handled?

Professional hygiene practices and clean tools are part of the service workflow. Specific requirements can be discussed before booking.

Do you work on editorial and runway projects?

Yes. Divya works across bridal, editorial beauty, runway presentation and fashion-focused creative projects.
